tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which of the following arrangements represents the increasing order (smallest to largest) of ionic radii of the given species $\mathrm{O}^{2-}, \mathrm{S}^{2-}, \mathrm{N}^{3-}, \mathrm{P}^{3-}$ ?

solution.text: For isoelectronic species ionic radii decreases as the charge on ion decreases. Further on moving down in a group ionic radii increases. Hence the correct order is $\mathrm{O}^{2-} < \mathrm{N}^{3-} < \mathrm{S}^{2-} < \mathrm{P}^{3-}$
